body:
CURRENT RULE (rev 2, 2026-10-28T01:11Z): acceptance evaluations RESUME under the AMENDED HYBRID that Greg adopted.
Greg's words, verbatim:
- #2170, 00:57:25Z: „chciałbym aby ewaluacje były przeprowadzane na maszynach remote”.
- #2177, 01:10:47Z: „TAK, akceptuję rekomendację rady — hybryda teraz dla obecnej kolejki. Windows B/Mac wykonują testy i obserwacje na dokładnym drzewie/buildzie; niezależny centralny ewaluator zapisuje werdykt w głównym store na podstawie zweryfikowanych hashami dowodów. Kryteria wymagające typowanego wyniku zdalnego pozostają otwarte, bez skrótów. Uruchomcie kolejkę ewaluacji.”
Both reached Engram through Advisor mailbox 74a6af16. Council record: w-bc25336d4389, with Architect3's disposition in note c289133e.
MODEL:
- Windows B and/or the Mac run the tests and observations on the exact tree or build. Use one suitable host per criterion; use both only when a criterion needs both.
- Central verifies each bundle byte-for-byte, stores it under .evidence and records it on the item, with honest assurance.
- An INDEPENDENT central evaluator (TermAl termal_evaluate_acceptance, never the implementer, holder, executor or lander) judges ALL criteria and records the verdict in the item's canonical store.
RULES:
- A gate --ref record, a note or a hash is NOT typed VerificationEvidence. A criterion bound with --bind stays open (insufficient_evidence) until typed remote-check admission exists. No shortcuts, no loosening bindings, no relabelling a mechanical criterion as judgment.
- Relayed text is never a record.
- Central-only effects are observed on central, with that exception named.
- Staleness: an observation counts only for the tree or build it names.
- Batch evidence per exact tree or build; each item keeps its own run, citations and receipt.
- Keep attempt and idempotency handling. Relay loss (503/409) means pending, never a rerun.
- Pilot one item end to end before scaling.
Landing still never waits for an evaluation. The old deferral (rules-greg-checkin-tests-review-stop-evaluations-2026-10-24 rev 3) is superseded. B (an evaluator native to the remote host, recording to the canonical store) remains the later target.
